summary: Author-proved uniform full radial minimum on 1/2-beta(6lambda)/16<=d<=1 with O(log log lambda) error, an explicit Euler-only moving range, and a genuine simple mixture root strictly below Re w=1 at the maximal stated shrinking width. Known zeta inputs are reused; no new zeta estimate or RH claim.

claims.title: Connected balance-curve loss budget
claims.statement: If ell is an analytic logarithm on a neighborhood of a rectangle [s,s+h]xI, A=Re ell prime>=a0>0, -J<=lambda+Re ell(s,x)<=-epsilon<0, a0*h>J and a0*|I|>2pi, there is a unique smooth balance graph and a simple genuine odd-phase zero over interior I.
hypotheses: Specified zero-free logarithm rectangle; nonzero prefactor in (6); inequalities in statement.
claims.domain: Any such rectangle for the exact factorization (6).
claims.parameter_scope: Every rectangle and parameter satisfying the finite hypotheses.
claims.error_bound: Phase variation at least a0*|I|; graph thickness <h.

claims.title: Moving right boundary from original Cauchy constants
claims.statement: If eta>0 tends to zero and eta^{-2}=o(log lambda), then R_{1/2+eta}=4lambda/pi+(8+2eta)log(lambda)/pi+O(eta^{-1}); a simple true upper root is included.
claims.parameter_scope: Every sufficiently large lambda along any admissible eta function.
claims.error_bound: Radial O(eta^{-1}); derivative loss O(eta^{-2}); cutoff exp(O(eta^{-2})); upper height O(eta^{-1}/log lambda).

claims.title: Interior normalized log-zeta estimates
claims.statement: On x>=10 and sigma>=1-beta(2x)/16, the Euler-normalized continuation g on Omega has |g|<=H(x) and |g prime|<=Z(x)=16H(x)/beta(2x), with explicit H in (17).
claims.domain: Omega={sigma-ix:x>4,sigma>1-beta(x)/2}; estimates on the stricter stated domain.
claims.parameter_scope: Every x>=10 and every sigma in the stated domain.

claims.title: Completed derivative and boundary value control
claims.statement: For fixed absolute X0 and x>=X0, sigma>=1-beta(2x)/16 implies Re D>=log x/4. For 3/4<=s<=2 in the same domain, |U(s,x)+pi*x/4-(s/2+3/2)log x|<=20+H(x).
claims.domain: All eligible high-ordinate vertical rays; boundary value estimate on the specified bounded real-part band.
claims.error_bound: Derivative loss C_E+Z(x)<=log x/4; value loss 20+H(x)=O(log log x).

claims.title: Fixed low-ordinate all-height exclusion
claims.statement: There are fixed eps0>0 and m0 such that log|P(sigma-ix)|>=m0 for sigma>=1-eps0 and 0<=x<=X0; hence no mixture root there when lambda>-m0.
hypotheses: X0 fixed before lambda; completed xi at w=1.
claims.error_bound: Fixed compact constants, no expanding-compact substitution.

evidence_refs.locator: section 6, paragraph preceding equation (23) and equation (23)

claims.title: All-height lower radius bound
claims.statement: Every eligible root has |z|>=X_front(lambda,s)-O(1+log log lambda), without an upper bound on its height or an exceptional root set.
hypotheses: lambda large enough for section 8 conditions.
claims.domain: 1-beta(6lambda)/16<=s<=3/2; d=s-1/2; all H_t zeros with |Im z|>=d; beta(v)=1/[54.004(log v)^{2/3}(log log v)^{1/3}]
claims.parameter_scope: Every sufficiently large real lambda, simultaneously for all s in the stated interval; absolute constants.
claims.error_bound: Radial lower loss O(1+log log lambda), absolute and uniform in s.

evidence_refs.locator: section 7, equation (25) and all three abscissa ranges

claims.title: Genuine simple odd-phase upper zero
claims.statement: For every allowed lambda,s there is a simple first-quadrant H_t zero with x=X_front+O(log log lambda), d<y<d+O(log log lambda/log lambda); its modulus is X_front+O(log log lambda).
hypotheses: lambda large enough for section 8 conditions.
claims.domain: 1-beta(6lambda)/16<=s<=3/2; d=s-1/2; all H_t zeros with |Im z|>=d; beta(v)=1/[54.004(log v)^{2/3}(log log v)^{1/3}]; constructed x lies in [lambda,2lambda].
claims.parameter_scope: Every sufficiently large real lambda, simultaneously for all s in the stated interval; absolute constants.
claims.error_bound: Connected x interval 16pi/log lambda; phase decrease >=4pi; radius O(log log lambda), height O(log log lambda/log lambda).

claims.title: Uniform full moving-boundary radial minimum
claims.statement: The full all-root infimum is finite and attained, and R_d=4lambda/pi+(2d+7)log(lambda)/pi+O(1+log log lambda), uniformly for the stated d range. Every minimizing first-quadrant representative has y=d+O(log log lambda/log lambda).
hypotheses: lambda large enough for section 8 conditions.
claims.domain: 1-beta(6lambda)/16<=s<=3/2; d=s-1/2; all H_t zeros with |Im z|>=d; beta(v)=1/[54.004(log v)^{2/3}(log log v)^{1/3}]
claims.parameter_scope: Every sufficiently large real lambda, simultaneously for all s in the stated interval; absolute constants.
claims.error_bound: Absolute O(1+log log lambda)=o(log lambda); no limiting constant claimed.

evidence_refs.locator: sections 1 and 7, equation (1), attainment and minimizer arguments

claims.title: Arbitrarily fast approach from above one
claims.statement: For any eta_plus>0 tending to zero, d=1/2+eta_plus satisfies the full radial formula of S01-GLOBAL, once eta_plus<=1/2.
hypotheses: eta_plus>0 and tends to zero; no lower rate bound.
claims.parameter_scope: Every sufficiently large lambda along any such eta_plus function.

claims.title: Full minimum slightly below one
claims.statement: For every 0<eta_minus<=beta(6lambda)/16, d=1/2-eta_minus satisfies the full radial formula of S01-GLOBAL.
claims.parameter_scope: Every sufficiently large real lambda, simultaneously for all s in the stated interval; absolute constants.
claims.error_bound: O(1+log log lambda), uniform in eta_minus; width is a strict fraction of a known zero-free width.

claims.title: Actual mixture zero strictly below one
claims.statement: With eta_minus=beta(6lambda)/16, the S01-UPPER zero has 1-eta_minus<Re w<1, equivalently 1/2-eta_minus<Im z<1/2.
claims.domain: Strict strip between the moving boundary and Re w=1; x in [lambda,2lambda].
claims.error_bound: Height excess O(log log lambda/log lambda)=o(eta_minus).

input_read_scope: Actually needed public sources listed in SOURCE_LEDGER.json; own output only. Quantitative full-file retrieval was partly truncated beyond the relied-on sections 2-3; no complete later-section audit is claimed.

new_information_about_zeta.explanation: No genuinely new zeta information established. The log and derivative estimates are standard consequences of the separate published value/zero-free inputs on a narrower region. New output is about the mixture.

comparison_evidence.locator: complete comparison table and following paragraphs

limitations: Unaudited first author proof; no formal or human verification claimed.
No extension to a fixed d<1/2, all Re w>1/2, RH, or a critical-line percentage.
No improvement of Bellotti zero-free or value constants; no zero-density result.
No numerical lambda0 or numerical root evidence; fixed compact constants are not numerically evaluated.
At very small eta_minus the constructed upper root may lie above Re w=1; strictly below is proved at the stated maximal width or when the displayed height condition holds.
Historical novelty not established by the bounded primary-source check.

above_one.eta_range: Every eta_plus>0 tending to zero, eventually <=1/2. Euler-only sufficient subrange eta_plus^{-2}=o(log lambda) separately proved.

compact_small_abscissa_evidence.locator: section 6, fixed compact rectangle and equation (23)

moving_boundary_report.scope_distinctions: Full minimum combines all-height lower exclusion over every smaller abscissa with a genuine odd-phase root. Upper construction is in [lambda,2lambda], while low ordinates and x>=3lambda are separately covered. See MOVING_BOUNDARY_REPORT.md.
